append:
# Android 16 debuggerd fallback records the kernel release in crash reports.
# This preserves the original fault report; it does not repair the codec fault.
uname: 1
scope: Allow only uname in the existing audio extension for Android16 fallback crash reporting. Original codec SIGSEGV is unresolved. Existing base policy, W^X restrictions, video policy and SELinux remain unchanged.
attribution: Inherited Qualcomm/The Linux Foundation policy from pinned Lineage primary-hal; local extension follows the pinned AOSP/Lineage debuggerd fallback requirement.
